query: I just got back from trying the new matcha croissant at the bakery down the street, it was so flaky and the matcha filling wasn’t too sweet at all, I’m already planning to go back tomorrow to try their lavender latte too. My cat also knocked over my potted succulent this morning, I had to clean soil off the kitchen counter for ten minutes, he’s lucky he’s so cute. Oh right, the reason I called is that I’m traveling abroad right now and my mobile data isn’t working at all—airplane mode is accidentally turned on, I think I picked the wrong network preference earlier, I also already used up all my data for the month, and I haven’t turned on roaming either, can you help me fix this?
